Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Richmond Virginia hearings on gay rights 2. Man stabs and kills homosexual, claims self defense, 2nd degree murder 3. New South Wales, Australian Chief Medical Officer, seeks to close all bathhouses in the nation, believes it is a "breeding ground for AIDS" COMMERCIAL: Chamberlain and Associates, career service professionals 4. Interview with Sue Li Bow, Director of Development for the Lesbian Rights Project, discusses family law and lesbian gay rights 5. Interview with Albuquerque's Common Bond president, Anne Doughty, discusses community center COMMERCIAL: "The Connection," gay and lesbian newspaper 6. Coming out COMMERCIAL: "The Times of Harvey Milk" 7. Sports including clip Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Gary MacDonald, Executive Director of the Federation of AIDS Related Organizations, discusses his organization 8. Closing Credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Media reports/current events/culture, includes Lawrence of Arabia clip and CNN news report on Gays and TV COMMERCIAL: "Manscape," a gay magazine 2. Sybil Bruncheon COMMERCIAL: National Fund for Human Dignity 3. Return to Sybil Bruncheon COMMERCIAL: Arco Blancos resort, San Juan, Puerto Rico 4. Commercials with Sybil COMMERCIAL: World of Video 5. Dr. Jim Serafini, Psychotherapist, discusses gay relationships, romance versus friendship
